title: Qatar Ministry of Communications and Information Technology Signs Post-Quantum Readiness Agreement with SignQuantum and QANplatform - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology of the State of Qatar (MCIT Qatar) has signed a collaboration agreement with Qatari cybersecurity firm SignQuantum, powered by quantum-resistant blockchain developer QANplatform, to evaluate post-quantum cryptography (PQC) workflows for public-sector data. Announced during MWC26 Doha on November 10, 2026, the initiative supports long-term data integrity goals under Qatar National Vision 2030 and Digital Agenda 2030.

Designed for organizations requiring long-term auditability, SignQuantum’s architecture anchors signed electronic transactions onto QANplatform’s distributed ledger. According to QANplatform Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer Johann Polecsak, pairing post-quantum signatures with immutable ledger anchoring mitigates future key-compromise and verification risks for government records.

Under the agreement signed alongside MCIT Digital Economy Department Director Faraj Jassim Abdulla, SignQuantum Chief Executive Officer Nazmath Nazeer, and MBK Holding Chairman Sheikh Mansoor Bin Khalifa Al-Thani, the parties will conduct technical knowledge sharing and assess candidate workflows, with any future pilot deployments or commercial contracts subject to separate government evaluation and procurement approvals.
